name: UGCA 92 (Hubble)
blurb: UGCA 92, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugca92-hubble
story: A dwarf irregular galaxy glimpsed through a zone of strong extinction by the dust of our own galaxy, once even catalogued as a possible planetary nebula. It is often considered a companion of the starburst galaxy NGC 1569.

claims.text: UGCA 92 (EGB 0427+63) is a dwarf irregular galaxy
UGCA 92 was independently catalogued as a possible planetary nebula
UGCA 92 is often considered a companion of the starburst galaxy NGC 1569
UGCA 92 is situated in a zone of strong extinction
The strong extinction is Galactic, i.e. from our own galaxy's dust
UGCA 92 was imaged by Hubble ACS in program 9771
